newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ANDERLECHT HIT BY INJURIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ANDERLECHT HIT BY INJURIES.

text.p: Injury-depleted Anderlecht said on Thursday they might recall key defender Suad Katana and striker Yaw Preko for Sunday's Belgian Cup final.

Bosnian Katana, who suffered a thigh injury earlier this week, is badly needed to shore up Anderlecht's defence against in-form Ekeren, scorers of 21 goals in their last five league games -- all of them victories.
Ekeren beat Antwerp 6-3 in their last league game of the season on Sunday while Anderlecht struggled to overcome lowly Mechelen 2-0.

The return of Preko, who suffered a calf injury playing for Ghana in a World Cup qualifier against Gabon last month, would be a welcome tonic for Anderlecht, whose main striker Gilles De Bilde left in mid-season.
Another striker, former Belgium international Josip Weber, quit soccer because of persistent knee problems.

A series of other regulars are nursing minor injuries but are expected to be fit. Goalkeeper Geert De Vlieger was sidelined for the Mechelen game with an ankle problem, defenders Samuel Johnson and Celestine Babayaro had knee and shoulder injuries and midfielders Danny Boffin and Walter Bassegio and striker Oleg Yaschuk all had thigh trouble.
Another midfielder, Frederic Peiremans, is not fully fit yet after having suffered mononucleosis.
Compared with Anderlecht, Ekeren's treatment room looked deserted.

Bosnian midfielder Cvijan Milosevic, dogged by a groin problemm was treated by a Dutch specialist on Wednesday, and should be fit. Hungarian defender Ervin Kovacs, hampered by a calf injury in recent weeks, was also back in action.
Ekeren have only suspended defender Nick Descamps missing.
